product: UP Election 2027 Political Intelligence Operating System
principles: Primary official sources outrank secondary reporting
2024 Lok Sabha data is never mislabeled as 2024 Assembly data
Conflicts become explicit data gaps rather than hidden guesses
Every AI answer carries provenance, freshness and confidence
Provider failure must degrade gracefully without fabricating an answer
Political intelligence remains analytical and non-targeted

layers.name: System Runtime
layers.scope: routing, health, provider orchestration, temporal clock

layers.name: Canonical Election Data
layers.scope: immutable UP election and booth datasets

layers.name: Official Evidence
layers.scope: ECI, CEO UP, UP Assembly, UP Government, SEC, PIB

layers.name: Live Intelligence
layers.scope: current politics, news, government updates, assembly activity

layers.name: Reasoning & AI
layers.scope: multi-provider synthesis grounded only in retrieved evidence

layers.name: Audit & Provenance
layers.scope: sources, timestamps, confidence, conflicts, provider trace

provider_strategy.primary: Cloudflare Workers AI binding when configured
provider_strategy.policy: No provider is trusted as a source of election facts; providers only synthesize supplied evidence.
